title: STNFS with a ball-region sieved descent: 2^122.128

claims.statement: For the full production bls12-381-fixed-g2-invert-g1 challenge, the STNFS algorithm of proof.md returns P in G1 with e(P,Q)=z for the supplied nonidentity Q with success at least 0.39 (declared bound 0.4227, proof.md sections 3 and 7) under heuristics H1-H6 (section 9). A global meter bounds all classical work by W <= 2^122.128 dense-Fp12-multiplication units at C=20,000 instructions; the ledger (section 8) totals 2^122.127008. Relation collection keeps the frontier's 2601/2500 work and 2401/2500 yield brackets; f-side ECM cofactor slack 295 (cofactors <= 303 bits), g-side slack 226 (cofactors <= 234 bits), each side priced by the explicit ecm16.py schedule at 99% (2^37.5177 / 2^37.5150, 2^38.5165 per survivor with the norm and trial-division charges). Retained yield 2^64.254, 0.424 bits above 1.3 U. The line sieve covers p in [2^8,2^40) and the record walk p in [2^40,2^63); every line-sieved hit with p >= 2^20 (the trial-division bound) is emitted as a record and charged 36 routing + 7.00 apply + 7.003 recovery per record, so factors above trial division are recovered and divided out before ECM (section 3, check [5d]). The production yield is a normal mean with the 2,401-row pool's standard error 0.1175 bits; the descent input is LOG2_RELS = 64.130 = floor(2^64.2541 - 1.05 x 0.1175), and the conditional success 0.5025 is multiplied by the charged 1.00-SE survival 0.8413 (H6), giving 0.4227. The boot keeps 8 relations (psi^8 = 2.1438e-02, psi = 0.61858, charged twice); two-log expectation 2^117.951, metered cap 2^119.14 (directed Markov 2^-1.189; exact 2^-1.18908). Linear algebra (26,5) blocks at 88/97 per entry, pad 1.61. Preprocessing is inside the total; no external advice, nothing amortized. Analytic exploratory claim, not a full-size run.

experiments.purpose: Recomputes the certificates, rho, pool, ledger, filtering, descent plan with retention model and ECM schedules, toys and audit; prints total_log2W_full_ledger and modelled_success.
